marks.gloss_en: אמר ליה רב פפא לרבא: כמאן? כרבי יהודה? אי כרבי יהודה, אפילו מים ומלח נמי! -- if your penalty follows R' Yehuda, forbid even water and salt
Rava penalized him [forbidding him] to sell even nuts
לעולם רבי שמעון, ובאיסורא דגופיה קנסינן ליה -- actually R' Shimon; the nuts are the very means of the prohibition: with them he enticed the butchers' children to bring him the thigh fat
actually, [the ruling is according to] R' Shimon
כיון דחשיד אדאורייתא כל שכן אדרבנן -- suspect where the prohibition is of Torah law, all the more where it is only rabbinic
the mishna's clause rests on the stam's reasoning: shviit and tithes are of Torah law, purity of rabbinic law
since he is suspect regarding [prohibitions of] Torah law, all the more so regarding [those of] rabbinic law
one suspect regarding this [the Sabbatical Year] and that [tithes] is suspect regarding ritually pure items
מאי טעמא? שביעית לא בעיא חומה, מעשר כיון דבעי חומה חמיר ליה -- tithe, needing the wall, is graver to him
the Sabbatical Year does not require the wall; tithe, since it requires the wall, is stringent to him
החשוד על המעשר -- מאי טעמא? מעשר אית ליה פדיון, שביעית ... לית ליה פדיון, חמירא ליה -- the Sabbatical Year, having no redemption, is graver to him
tithe has redemption; the Sabbatical Year, since it is forbidden to him and has no redemption, is stringent to him
מאי טעמא? נהי אדרבנן חשיד, אדאורייתא לא חשיד -- the stam's reason for the mishna's clause
נאמן על הטהרות נאמן על שביעית -- הא חשיד חשיד: the diyuk drawn from the baraita's wording
ורמינהו: נאמן על הטהרות נאמן על שביעית -- הא חשיד חשיד! the baraita implies one suspect on purity is suspect on shviit, against the mishna (kind tanya: the ורמינהו cites a baraita)
what is the reason? granted he is suspect regarding rabbinic law; regarding Torah law he is not suspect
דאמרינן מיגו -- R' Yannai's own reason for his okimta
כגון דהוה חשיד לתרווייהו... והדר איחשד אחד מינייהו, מיגו דחשיד אהא חשיד נמי אאידך -- the baraita is one who accepted both and was again suspected on one (= p_yannai_okimta, p_yannai_migo)
R' Yannai b'R' Yishmael: [the baraita is] where he was suspect regarding both, came before the Rabbis and accepted both, and was then suspected again regarding one of them
דבאתריה דרבי יהודה שביעית חמירא להו -- why the Sages of version 1 are R' Yehuda
דההוא דהוה קרי ליה לחבריה דיירא בר דיירתא -- the anecdote evidencing that shviit was held stringent there (kind svara: no kind names anecdote-as-evidence)
who are the Sages [who say shviit -> tithe]? R' Yehuda
רבי מאיר היא, דאמר: חשוד לדבר אחד הוי חשוד לכל התורה כולה
version 2: this [clause, one suspect on tithe is not suspect on shviit] is the view of R' Akiva, the unattributed
מתניתין כשראינוהו שנוהג בצינעא בתוך ביתו -- the mishna is a man seen to conduct himself properly in private (= p_ilai_okimta)
R' Ilai: our mishna is where they saw him conduct himself privately within his house
version 1: this [clause, one suspect on shviit is not suspect on tithe] is the view of R' Akiva, the unattributed
